descFull: Agent! now supports macOS 14.6 or later, Apple Silicon and Intel (see latest pre-release). The Best AI agent for Mac: drives any app via Accessibility, codes/builds in Xcode, automates AppleScript, JXA, Swift and SMAppService shell (user/root). 23 LLM providers, local/cloud, plus on-device Apple Intelligence and Jev guard. MCP support.
